## 中文

### 新增与使用方法

- 新增单网卡模式（电脑与 PS5 连接同一路由器）和双网卡模式（另一块网卡直连 PS5）。选择物理网卡后，可自动添加服务 IP，并在不用时清除本工具新增的配置。
- 保留电脑原有 IP、DHCP、默认网关和 DNS。已有地址不会被登记为本工具新增地址，也不会被清除；配置记录支持中断后检查与清理。增加网段冲突检查、操作互斥和应用单实例保护。
- 默认服务地址为 `192.168.100.1/24`，支持其他末位为 `.1` 的私有 IPv4 地址。配置后自动选中服务地址，并显示 PS5 建议参数；中英文界面、README 和详细指南同步更新。

在“连接模式与电脑 IP 配置”选择模式、网卡和服务 IP，停止本地服务及下载、传输任务后点击“自动配置 IP”，按系统提示授权。PS5 参数仍需手动设置，并在应用中保存相同的 PS5 地址。单网卡模式需要路由器允许设备互访；双网卡模式请选择没有默认网关的直连网卡。

新增地址为本次开机期间的临时配置，退出软件会保留，重启后需重新配置。点击“清除本工具配置”仅清除本工具新增项；不会重置整块网卡。若其他软件新增的静态地址依赖共存设置，工具会保留该设置及清理记录并提示检查。配置失败或结果不明确时，先检查提示并清理，再重试。

### 兼容性与验证范围

Windows 使用 DHCP／静态地址共存及临时地址，macOS 使用临时 IPv4 alias；需要系统授权。无法确认 Windows 共存状态时停止自动配置。原网段与其他网卡或路由重叠时，请选用不冲突的私有网段并同步调整 PS5。PS5 网关和 DNS 填写电脑服务 IP 仅用于本地访问，本工具不启用网络共享或桥接。

`npm ci`、83 项自动化测试和差异格式检查通过。Windows Electron 模拟接口验证覆盖两种模式、配置与清除、原有地址保护提示、中英文切换以及桌面和窄窗口布局。

在一台 Windows 电脑上，通过应用配置模块及辅助进程实际测试了有线和 Wi-Fi 添加、清除临时 IP：新增地址的本机 TCP 通信成功，测试期间公网 HTTPS 请求成功，清除后所有网卡的原有地址、DHCP、网关、DNS 和共存设置与测试前一致。该测试没有改变 PS5 网络设置。尚未验证 PS5 端互通、macOS 实机、原本没有可用地址的直连网卡及重启后的失效行为；构建成功不代表上述实机验证完成。

### 发布包与说明

Windows x64 提供安装版与便携版；macOS Intel、Apple Silicon 分别提供 DMG 和 ZIP，附 `SHA256SUMS.txt`。三平台构建及发布后下载校验结果见本次标签对应的 Actions。所有包未代码签名，macOS 未公证。

本项目仅供技术交流和合法授权测试，处理用户自行提供或有权使用的内容。构建包不附带网页资源、第三方 ELF、Y2JB 下载数据或游戏内容；第三方资源由用户主动下载并遵守其许可。软件按现状提供，不保证效果，使用者承担自身操作责任；相关权利归第三方所有。完整边界与免责声明见 README。

## English

### Additions and usage

- Add single-adapter mode (computer and PS5 on a shared router) and two-adapter mode (a separate adapter wired to PS5). Select a physical adapter to add a service IP automatically and clear the app-added configuration afterward.
- Preserve existing computer IPs, DHCP, default gateways and DNS. Pre-existing addresses are never claimed or removed. A durable record supports inspection and cleanup after interruptions. Add subnet conflict checks, operation coordination and single-instance protection.
- Default to `192.168.100.1/24`, with support for other private IPv4 addresses ending in `.1`. Successful configuration selects the service address and displays suggested PS5 settings. Update both interface languages, READMEs and detailed guides.

Under “Connection mode and computer IP setup,” select the mode, adapter and service IP. Stop local services, downloads and transfers, click “Configure IP automatically,” and complete system authorization. Enter PS5 settings manually and save the same PS5 address in the app. A shared router must allow client communication; two-adapter mode requires a direct-connect adapter without a default gateway.

Added addresses are temporary for the current boot. Closing the app retains them; configure again after restarting the computer. “Clear app-added configuration” removes only the app's additions without resetting the adapter. If another application's new static address requires coexistence, the setting and cleanup record are retained with an explanation. Inspect and clean up failed or unconfirmed operations before retrying.

### Compatibility and verification scope

Windows uses DHCP/static-address coexistence and temporary addresses; macOS uses temporary IPv4 aliases. System authorization is required. Automatic configuration stops if Windows coexistence cannot be verified. If an existing adapter or route overlaps, choose another private subnet and adjust PS5 settings. Using the computer service IP as PS5 gateway and DNS provides local connectivity only; the app does not enable internet sharing or bridging.

`npm ci`, all 83 automated tests and diff formatting checks pass. Windows Electron checks with mocked APIs cover both modes, configuration and cleanup, pre-existing address protection feedback, language switching, and desktop and narrow-window layouts.

Actual Ethernet and Wi-Fi address addition and cleanup were tested on one Windows computer through the app's configuration module and helper process. Local TCP communication using the added address and public HTTPS requests succeeded. After cleanup, all adapters' original addresses, DHCP, gateways, DNS and coexistence settings matched the baseline. PS5 network settings were not changed. PS5-side communication, macOS hardware operation, an initially unaddressed direct-connect adapter and expiration after reboot remain unverified. Successful builds do not establish those hardware results.

### Packages and notice

Windows x64 includes installer and portable packages. macOS Intel and Apple Silicon each include DMG and ZIP packages, with `SHA256SUMS.txt`. See the Actions run for this tag for platform builds and verification of downloaded release assets. All packages are unsigned; macOS packages are not notarized.

For technical exchange and authorized testing of user-provided or authorized content. Builds do not bundle web resources, third-party ELFs, Y2JB download data or game content. Third-party downloads require user action and remain subject to their licenses. The software is provided as-is without guaranteed results; users are responsible for their actions, and third-party rights remain with their owners. See the README for the full boundaries and disclaimer.
